## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass.
- [ ] Tests added or updated for any change to security or cost logic.
- [ ] No secret, token, key, code or VIN in code, tests, logs or URLs.
- [ ] Naming and branding rules respected (no restricted trademark in names, no third-party logos or copied assets).
- [ ] No new polling or background call to the vehicle API.
- [ ] User-facing strings exist in English and French.
